notes.title: A Roly Poly Firework
notes.content:
Firework Simulator is coming out soon!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2271890/Firework_Simulator/

It's a simulator where you play with and make fireworks.

There's a bunch of different fireworks in it including the Roly Poly, themed on this game. This is what it looks like:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42219326/3b09f4aa25b2bee03a4f95cd7b203b6194e33e3e.png[/img]

It spins then pops (sometimes it rolls). Here's a video of it in action:

[url=https://twitter.com/Echomune/status/1613994484127387653]https://twitter.com/Echomune/status/1613994484127387653[/url]

There's a firework for Raccoon Tales, WIGWWAG, Little Horror Raiser and The Game Store too. Videos of each of those fireworks will be up on Twitter in the next few days.

Follow [url=https://twitter.com/echomune]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/echomune/]Instagram [/url]and [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC2MxF-3onC1D-30z8lmd8nA]Youtube [/url]for upcoming stuff.

notes.title: Roly Poly is in the Steam Summer Sale!
notes.content:
Guess what! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1906750/Roly_Poly/]Roly Poly[/url] is in the Steam Summer Sale.

See what it's like to live a regular day as a roly poly/potato bug/pill bug/wood louse/etc. With multiple different endings.

Raccoon Tales is also on sale!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1963180/Raccoon_Tales/

They take place in the same universe, it's sort of like the thing Marvel does but this isn't the MCU it's the uh, Isopod/Raccoon [strike]cinematic[/strike] gaming universe. The IRGU... Ok that's not the name but you get the idea.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42219326/e2171e32d3d05f0f51628021abc82876e3ed6690.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Roly Poly x Raccoon Tales
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1963180/Raccoon_Tales/]Raccoon Tales[/url] has released! A new stealth game by echomune where you play as a raccoon.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1963180/Raccoon_Tales/

What does that have to do with this Roly Poly game? If you already got all the endings on this and are planning to play Raccoon Tales don't read further due to spoilers.

...

...

...

[b]!! Spoilers ahead !![/b]

...

...

If you got the slide ending where you run into a strange creature in an alley, this game will resolve that.

It's on the second level of Raccoon Tales, find a way behind the Root Beer Bar.

There's more connections on one of the later levels too.

notes.title: Roly Poly - Released! 10% Launch Discount!
notes.content:
[b]Roly Poly is out now! [/b]It has a launch discount of 10%

It's an adventure and platforming game where you play as a roly poly bug. Eat foods, talk with other roly polies and discover all of the different endings.
